notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 11 September
notes.notes:
New Features
Added quality settings for SSAO, including higher quality options

Added quality settings for Volumetric Fog, with the ability to set higher quality or turn it off completely

Added option to disable shadows from the sun and moon

Added setting to reduce background load when the game is not focused

Added setting to scale the UI

Added setting to adjust font size (increase or decrease)

Added wind particle effects when in forests

Added more sounds to UI navigation

Added a progress bar to track settlement influence progression

Characters in the creation menu can now be rotated by clicking or using the scroll wheel

Unlooted enemies now spawn a pouch containing their loot when despawning
Improvements
Upgraded visual effects for combat, including:

New visual effects for Perfect Avoidance

New visual effects for special attack hits

New visual effects for boons and buffs

New visual effects for berserk and berserker attacks

Upgraded floating combat text with improved animations, scaling, readability, and flow

Added colors and symbols to floating combat text to represent damage types

Floating combat text can now be disabled, or limited by turning off the self-healing display

Increased motion interaction between player and vegetation

Upgraded and standardized UI colors and sizes for a more consistent and harmonious look across menus and elements

Upgraded graphics of UI pop-up notifications

Upgraded map icons and player arrow

Upgraded overall UI visuals to feel less flat

Upgraded Lynx Instinct bar UI

Upgraded skill UI for clarity and readability

Upgraded item UI visuals

Merged effects view into a single column

Added more in-game hints

Added lore text for many creatures and characters
Gameplay
Decreased wind-up animation for Lynx Opportunistic Strike, making the backstab attack quicker and more responsive

NPCs can now drop schillings (coins) in addition to items

Updated loot table for Landsknechts

Damage types updated: Physical damage has been split into Blunt and Pierce. All damage types now have distinct icons and colors in floating combat text. Current damage types are:

Blunt

Pierce

Pure

Trolldom

Seidr

Fire
Fixes
Opening menus now prevents character movement

Fixed a bug where enemies flinched by back attacks would glitch out

Fixed some weapon colliders on Fossegrim melee attacks so they can hit the player in Lynx form

Fixed waterfall sounds in Klubbvik. Waterfalls should now be heard more clearly

Reduced the size of the Bogbean model

Fixed a visual bug on the Draugr where seaweed was not displaying correctly

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 4 August
notes.notes:
While we're building up for our next major content update, we've added some more graphic settings and quality-of-life features that have been requested by players. We've also continued our UI overhaul. Lastly, after hours and hours of meticulous debugging, we found and fixed the performance issue that had caused some frame drops since the June patch. The good news is that we squeezed in a few more optimizations along the way.


New Features
A new chest has appeared in your player house and reclaimed farms. Its contents are shared across all locations. Perhaps a gift from the "Gardsvord", the old farm spirits.

Players can now transfer and drop gold. No more excuses for not sharing your precious skillings with your friends.

Added option to turn Upscaling off. For purists, skeptics, and people whose PCs could heat a small cabin

Added settings to set a max frame rate

Added player setting for display mode (fullscreen or windowed)
Improvements
Major rework of UI buttons and tabs. All buttons and tabs are now more unified in design, and properly respond to hover, click, and selection states.
Fixes
Fixed an issue with outdoor ground textures that caused a massive drop in frame rate

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 25 July
notes.notes:
New Features

Added options to enable Vsync
Dialogue responses can now be selected using hotkeys
Added new fur type for the Lynx form (Supporter Pack only)
Added more in-game hints


Improvements

Major architectural change to tree rendering:
The old GPU instanced indirect tree system has been replaced with a fully data-oriented approach using Unity’s Entities system (ECS). This improves culling, batching, and logic control of vegetation, offering significatly better performance and more flexibility for gameplay features.
Updated lighting and atmosphere in the Prologue
Many general visual improvements

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 13 July
notes.notes:
Map Updates

Improved world map quality
Submaps now better scale to different map ratios
Made the map navigable using a controller
Fixed bug where player bag did not appear on the map after death


New Features

Added graphic options for upscaler quality (DLSS and FSR)
Added feature to split inventory items into custom amounts


Improvements

Improved visual fidelity of many ground textures
Improved quality of many nature assets


Fixes

Fixed collider for the Loft in Bardestad to allow traversal through upstairs door

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 26 June
notes.notes:
New Features
Added a new main story quest  

Added detailed maps of settlements with markers for key locations such as player chests and merchants  

Added game hints and tutorials to assist with game mechanics


Improvements
Significant quality upgrade to ground textures  

Updated UI graphics and functionality, including highlights when hovering, more unified resolution, added item categories, and upgraded item tooltips  

Adjusted Eydigard environments to reduce complete darkness during nighttime  

Updated many localizations for improved consistency  

Many environment and prop adjustments in the Skartind dungeon  

Updated boss encounter for Galdmundr, now located in a dedicated boss room with upgraded mechanics 

Changed map zoom to zoom in and out relative to the cursor position


Gameplay Changes
Eydigards are now cleansed by interacting directly with Pesta  

Added gatherable fish in rivers, lakes, and the sea  

Swimming mechanics updated: players will now slowly drown if they run out of stamina while in water  

Renamed the lynx resource from "Awareness" to "Instinct"  

Reduced crafting cost for Haugspira

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes June 13
notes.notes:
New Features

Players can now remap movement keys
Added settings for shadow quality, enabling players to select higher quality shadows than before
Added gamma (brightness) adjustment setting
Added Steam Cloud Save
Added the ability for players to quit to the main menu directly from the game


Improvements

Updated ranged combat:
  - Quivers now increase draw speed and aiming speed
  - Gunpowder horn now increases reload speed and damage
Updated cheat sheet to show additional hints
Updated skill tree UI to better display available skills for training
Adjusted attack animations for smoother blending and combo transitions
Adjusted and increased lynx bite hit registration size
Updated Undirveg entrance model
  - Entrances added as discoverable points of interest on the map
Added more item icons for various items
Some UI buttons now highlight on mouse hover


Fixes

Multiplayer dialogue log no longer interrupts player movement

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 30 May 2025
notes.notes:
New Features


Added functionality for rebinding keys
Added key binding for autorun



Improvements


Opening a crafting station now activates the relevant category automatically
Scrollbars are only interactable when a controller is connected
Added "Trade Item" as a new item type
Added new model for Bogbean herb

Added larger player chest in Glimrheim
Increased scrolling speed on scrolls and lists
Updated visuals for doors to the Undirveg
Removed confusing props in player house in Glimrheim
Made player-dropped items static to prevent floating or incorrect placement



Fixes


Quest “Deeper Than Silence” is now possible to complete
Fixed client not receiving host character customization
Fixed bug where not all quest dialogue was sent to all players in a game
Made join code copy-button hidden in local games
Fixed player invulnerability while entering/exiting instanced dungeons to prevent dying in the “void”

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 25 May 2025
notes.notes:
Improvements

Player death marker now persists through save/load so you can find your dropped items
Some NPCs will now acknowledge your heritage and provide different dialogue based on your character's background
Added more item descriptions
Added more item and creature localizations
Added ragdoll physics to Red Fox

Fixes

Fixed bug where character rig would break when using ranged weapons
Fixed Lynx jaw damage box size so bite abilities now properly register hits on enemies
Fixed gold values of items
Fixed farm buildings disappearing when viewed from a distance

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes - 21 May
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes


Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck after killing an enemy
Fixed a bug where the glittering effect from gatherables showed even if the gatherable hadn’t respawned



Gameplay


Added a vendor to Olderbach
Workbenches now share the same design and are easier to locate. Workbenches added to Thyristrand and Skievva
Alchemist tables now share the same design. Alchemist table added to Thyristrand
NPC names are now localized
Quadropeds no longer tilt if the character is not grounded. Lynx jumps should feel smoother
Skievva village reworked: added vendor hut, workbench, and cooking trainer hut. Villagers now follow clearer work routines and are easier to find
Gjermund will complete the Sulfur quest after Thyristrand is upgraded to level 2

notes.title: Eydigard Hotfix – 18 May
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 Solved an issue where saving didn’t work after being in the areas: Wyvern cave, Kringhei, Birkarl camp

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes – 15 May
notes.notes:
Fixed Issues


Fixed display issues with special characters (ø, æ, å), which now render at the correct size.
Resolved bugs affecting all Sámi-related quests.
Fixed multiple issues with kill quests not tracking or updating correctly.
Solved a bug where plague effects remained at Bokkergard even after cleansing.
Fixed an issue where some bear abilities failed to register hits on enemies.
Addressed a bug that prevented switching from the crafting view to the equipment view.
Fixed several cases of missing item names.
The Saivo portal is now visible for clients in multiplayer sessions.
Solved a bug where Ursine Vitality was re-applied on each new game start, causing players to gain increasingly higher health.



Gameplay & Systems


Reinite now respawns in Skartind after some time (approx. 1 hour).
Eira in Thyristrand can now buy and sell goods.
Gunpowder weapon aiming has been reworked and should now feel significantly more accurate.
You now see which crafting station type you are using in the crafting window.



Visuals & UI


Added new color variations for the bear form — these can now be selected.
Numerous small UI bug fixes and polish across menus and interfaces.
Game build size has been optimized — reduced by approximately 1.7 GB.

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes – 09 May
notes.notes:
Additions & Improvements:

 Added Snute, a friendly dog now found in Glimrheim.
 Signposts have been added to shops and key buildings in the main village for easier navigation.
 Expanded the number of Points of Interest shown on the map.
 Introduced larger chests to reclaimed farms to support extended storage.
 Most items now stack up to 20 (previously 10 or 5), reducing inventory clutter.
 Added more huntable animals to the world.


Visual Updates:

 Updated item and effect icons.
 Improved visuals for birch trees.


Gameplay Updates:

 Updated gunpowder weapons (more ammunitions, better aim).
 Adjusted sulfur spawn locations for better balance and discoverability.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed numerous minor bugs and inconsistencies with localization and quests

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes – 06 May
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:


     Fixed a bug where buildings at Fagrheim farm would not appear correctly.
     Resolved an issue with Astri’s quest that could block progression.
     Fixed various minor visual bugs and updated select textures.


Improvements:

     Added player chests to all farms in the Elvegard region.
     Refined visuals in the prologue area, including updates to nature and scenery.
     Updated flower spawns in bogs.

notes.title: Eydigard Patch Notes – 04 May
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:


     Fixed an issue where players were respawned at incorrect locations in reclaimed farms. This occasionally caused players to become stuck.
     Resolved a lighting issue where intense flickering occurred during dusk and dawn, particularly when the sun hovered near the horizon.


Improvements:


     Updated Thyristrand vendor inventory and dialogue
     Refined player chests in reclaimed farms to ensure correct placement and interaction.

notes.title: Hotfix – Improved World Loading (May 03)
notes.notes: World Loading Performance: We’ve drastically improved how the game loads terrain and assets in the background as you move through the world. This should eliminate the random camera jumps and spinning mouse issues that could happen while exploring.

notes.title: Eydigard Update Notes – May 02
notes.notes:
Fixes & Improvements:


 Player Gear Drop: Items now correctly drop at the death position, not the final ragdoll location. This fixes the issue where gear could sink through the world if the player died during a "get-up" transition.
     Lighting: Improved nighttime lighting and resolved several light probe issues. Visibility and atmosphere should now feel more consistent.
     Quest Fixes: Several bugs affecting quest progression have been resolved.
     UI Navigation (Controllers): Fixed hand controller navigation issues in menus and UI elements.
     Localization: Addressed bugs affecting localization of item names and UI. Journal categories now update correctly when changing language mid-session.
     Character Clipping: Fixed a bug where the male player character’s head would clip through clothing while walking.
     Controller Support: Added controller button icons for the ability bar and the in-game cheat sheet.
     Farm Upgrades: Fixed a bug where upgrades to farms were not always saving correctly.
